title: At the Cafe
text:
Ana goes to a cafe with her friend Luis. The menu has soup, pizza and salad. Ana wants a salad.

Luis wants pizza and orange juice. The pizza costs five dollars. They pay at the counter and sit by the window.

questions.text: What does Luis want to drink?
What kind of place is the cafe?
options: A place where you order and pay for food

questions.text: Why did Luis probably choose pizza?

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks that you can order in a restaurant
a dish of mixed vegetables, often eaten cold
a long table where you order or pay in a shop or cafe
an opening in a wall with glass that lets in light

paragraph_translations: Ana va a una cafetería con su amigo Luis. El menú tiene sopa, pizza y ensalada. Ana quiere una ensalada.
Luis quiere pizza y jugo de naranja. La pizza cuesta cinco dólares. Ellos pagan en el mostrador y se sientan junto a la ventana.
